title: Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica
author: Isaac Newton
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 / Sourced from Wikimedia Commons
alt_text: An old, slightly stained parchment title page of Sir Isaac Newton's book, 'Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica,' printed in 1687. The Latin text is printed in a classic serif font inside a simple double-bordered rectangular frame, featuring the book's title prominently at the top, followed by Newton's name, an official printing approval signed by Samuel Pepys dated 1686, and the publication details for London in Roman numerals at the bottom.
